# Camp Ally: Grandma Junko

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Aug 23, 2023
- 2 min read

Updated: Dec 17, 2023

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7a856f0371f94e6b8532f7a8abddbd8b~mv2.png)

Images credit: DSJ

#### **Type**

Lite Ally

Lite Allies do not offer a daily/repeatable quest, they are most often vendors and offer buffs in return for you letting them sleep at your camp.

#### **Specialises in**

She's Japanese. Sassy and grandmotherly in her dialog. You can also tell her stories about things you've done if you've completed the various main quests in the game.

#### **Faction**

N/A

#### **Lore**

Grandma Junko's background can be found here.

#### **Camp Item**

Grandma's Chair

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a2bedd197c344326aa41f09a73c3105e~mv2.jpg)

#### **Flamingo Units**

2x Flamingo Unit

Flamingo Unit camp item cost __spreadsheet__ 

#### **Obtainable from**

- Season 14 scoreboard - Fight for Freedom
- Gold Bullion - Samuel at Foundation or Mortimer at Crater (TBC) once you have reached Ally status.

#### **Daily Quest**

N/A

#### **Buffs/Services**

All buffs last 60 mins.

There is a 24-hour cool-down period on all buffs and services excluding the Well Rested/Lover's Embrace buff.

Well Rested - +5% XP for 3 hours

**Grandma's Home Cooked Meal buff**

Cost: Free

Buff: Fills hunger and thirst meters and freezes them (keeps them filled) for an hour.

#### **Health Bar (HP)**

534 HP
